title: The Tithe of Teeth
text: Under the cathedral, behind a door of rib-bones, something is owed a tithe, and this Year it has written down what it wants: teeth. Lots of them. The letter is addressed to the richest House in the city.

outcomes.text: You melt down a strongbox and cast a jawful of golden teeth. The door of rib-bones closes a little, satisfied.
Two of your recruits go down the steps with a pair of pliers and come back up with closed mouths. The thing below is very pleased. It sends gifts.

options.label: Refuse, and brick up the door.

outcomes.text: The bricks hold. In the morning every House in the city finds its children's milk teeth gone from their keepsake boxes.
